ne5c56a79fb.headline: Ramaphosa chairs inaugural meeting of Presidential Economic Advisory Council
ne5c56a79fb.summary: President Ramaphosa chaired the inaugural meeting of the Presidential Economic Advisory Council, stressing its role as the government of national unity seeks to reignite growth.
ne5c56a79fb.why: Economic advisory councils shape policy on growth, employment and fiscal priorities that affect South African assets and investor confidence.

n947dd748d2.headline: LemFi secures $53M in Series Bfunding led by Highland Europe
n947dd748d2.summary: Fintech LemFi raised $53 million in Series B funding led by Highland Europe, with existing investors participating, bringing its total capital raised to $85 million.
n947dd748d2.why: LemFi is a fintech focused on cross-border financial services for immigrant communities, and venture rounds like this signal investor appetite for payments startups.

nc63347cd84.headline: Indonesia Considers Importing Russian Oil After Joining BRICS
nc63347cd84.summary: Indonesia, a new BRICS member, is considering importing cheap Russian oil. The article says it faces challenges in complying with US sanctions.
nc63347cd84.why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy and a major energy importer, so its crude sourcing shapes regional oil demand. Russian crude is subject to Western sanctions, which complicate trade finance and shipping.

nfd7d963f37.headline: Gov't hints at plans to merge VRA, Bui Power Authority
nfd7d963f37.summary: Energy Minister-designate John Abdulai Jinapor hinted at merging the Volta River Authority and Bui Power Authority to streamline power sector operations, pending his approval.
nfd7d963f37.why: The Volta River Authority is Ghana's major state power generator, and power-sector restructuring affects utility efficiency and the government's fiscal exposure to state energy firms.

n6745fadedb.headline: Mankind Pharma slapped with GST penalty of Rs 2.27 crore
n6745fadedb.summary: Mankind Pharma disclosed in a regulatory filing that it received a GST penalty order of Rs 2.27 crore from the Kolkata South CGST and CX commissioner's office.
n6745fadedb.why: Mankind Pharma is an Indian pharmaceutical company, and tax penalties affect its compliance costs and reported earnings.

n6855d20b7d.headline: BTG Study: Brazil's Debt to Hit 86% of GDP by 2026
n6855d20b7d.summary: A BTG Pactual study projects Brazil's debt will reach 86 per cent of GDP by 2026. It warns that the nominal deficit has risen to one of the highest levels globally.
n6855d20b7d.why: Public debt levels shape sovereign risk premiums, interest rates and the outlook for Brazilian assets.

nc5bd076cfb.headline: Intesa Sanpaolo, first Italian bank to open to bitcoin
nc5bd076cfb.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo bought 11 bitcoins worth about USD 1 million, a symbolic amount, according to Milano Finanza, with CEO Carlo Messina explaining the move.
nc5bd076cfb.why: Intesa Sanpaolo is one of Italy's largest banks, and bank exposure to crypto assets is a growing topic for regulators and investors.

impacts.name: Intesa Sanpaolo
impacts.why: The bank itself made the bitcoin investment.

n975e206ea7.headline: Mexico's Industrial Transformation Plan Faces Challenges
n975e206ea7.summary: The Mexican government unveiled a plan to reshape the economy, aiming to boost existing sectors and spark growth in new ones.
n975e206ea7.why: Industrial policy in Mexico shapes manufacturing investment, nearshoring decisions and the outlook for peso-denominated assets.

ne39d8e5253.headline: ECB must be prudent with rate cuts given high uncertainty
ne39d8e5253.summary: Two top ECB officials said the bank is likely to keep easing policy this year but must be cautious. Exceptional uncertainty from possible trade war and domestic politics clouds the outlook.
ne39d8e5253.why: The European Central Bank sets interest rates for the euro area, influencing borrowing costs, bond yields and the euro's value.

n25e49bb2ae.headline: B3 Stock Exchange Sees 20.6% Jump in December Trading Volume
n25e49bb2ae.summary: B3, Brazil's leading stock exchange, reported a 20.6% increase in trading activity for December 2024. The company disclosed the figures on Tuesday.
n25e49bb2ae.why: B3 operates Brazil's main securities, derivatives and clearing market, so its trading volumes reflect local market activity and revenue.

ne86a378290.headline: Spain hosted record 94 mn foreign tourists in 2024
ne86a378290.summary: Spain recorded a record 94 million foreign tourist arrivals in 2024. The tourism sector is cited as a key driver of the country's economic growth.
ne86a378290.why: Tourism is a major contributor to Spain's GDP and employment, so visitor numbers feed into consumer spending, services revenue and the broader Spanish economy.

n46506d4cda.headline: Experts put money on early rate cut as spending slides
n46506d4cda.summary: A decline in household goods spending has boosted hopes of a Reserve Bank of Australia rate cut. Experts say the spending slide supports an earlier easing.
n46506d4cda.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives Australian bond yields, the Australian dollar and borrowing costs.

n23451384ab.headline: Shell Invests in Expanding Chinese Petrochemicals Business
n23451384ab.summary: Shell is expanding its joint-venture petrochemical complex in China, betting on continued growth in petrochemical demand in the world's largest oil importer.
n23451384ab.why: Shell is a major global oil and gas company with a large chemicals business. Petrochemical capacity investments shape long-term demand for crude and feedstock.

n47628f8caf.headline: West Sussex County Council leader calls on the government to reconsider farming Inheritance Tax changes
n47628f8caf.summary: The leader of West Sussex County Council urged the government to reconsider Inheritance Tax changes he said would have a devastating impact on many family farms.
n47628f8caf.why: Inheritance Tax rules affect how farm estates are passed on and valued, which matters for UK agricultural asset values and farm investment.

n1301e7c140.headline: Prices of Ghana’s major export commodities to surge this year - Data Bank research
n1301e7c140.summary: Data Bank expects strong price performance this year for Ghana's main exports, gold and cocoa. It cites geopolitical tensions, potential US Fed rate cuts and supply shortfalls as drivers.
n1301e7c140.why: Gold and cocoa are major export commodities for Ghana, so their prices shape export earnings and the country's external finances.

nb7e982cef4.headline: India's fiscal conditions to constrain credit strength in 2025: Moody's
nb7e982cef4.summary: Moody's said India's fiscal conditions will continue to constrain its credit strength in 2025. It added that tension in US-China relations could benefit India.
nb7e982cef4.why: Credit ratings from agencies such as Moody's influence sovereign borrowing costs and foreign investor appetite for Indian debt.

n8227ca33af.headline: Ghana has substantial potential in revenue mobilisation - Finance Minister-designate
n8227ca33af.summary: Finance Minister-designate Cassiel Ato Baah Forson told a vetting committee that Ghana has substantial potential in revenue mobilisation. He said tax increases would be unnecessary.
n8227ca33af.why: Ghana's fiscal policy and revenue plans shape its public debt position, which matters for investors in its sovereign bonds.

n2a1034b079.headline: Government login service DigiD frozen in large-scale cyberattack
n2a1034b079.summary: A DDoS attack paralysed DigiD, the main login service for Dutch government services, on Tuesday afternoon. Logius said users were unable to access services for more than five hours.
n2a1034b079.why: DigiD is the Netherlands' main digital identity system for government services such as tax filing, so outages affect public services and digital security.

n78ccac5391.headline: Canada carbon rebate goes out today as future of carbon tax remains unclear
n78ccac5391.summary: The first carbon rebate of 2025 is being paid to households in provinces using the federal carbon pricing system. The future of the rebate program remains uncertain.
n78ccac5391.why: Canada's federal carbon pricing system affects energy costs for households and businesses, and changes to it shape fiscal and energy policy.

n3e67f21201.headline: India poised to become world's 4th largest economy by 2026; GDP to grow 6.8% in FY25: PHDCCI
n3e67f21201.summary: PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry projects India will overtake Japan to become the fourth-largest economy by 2026, with GDP growing 6.8% in FY25.
n3e67f21201.why: India's growth outlook is a key driver for global investors allocating to emerging markets, and rankings by economic size shape investment sentiment.

nd844d90d56.headline: Ghanaians unjustifiably pay more for local fuel distribution than importation costs from Europe — ACEP
nd844d90d56.summary: The Africa Centre for Energy Policy found Ghanaians pay significantly more to transport fuel from depots to retail outlets than it costs to import fuel from Europe.
nd844d90d56.why: Fuel pricing and distribution margins directly affect consumer inflation and the cost base of transport and industry in import-dependent economies.

n684819c003.headline: Barrick Gold suspends operations in Mali after $245m gold seizure
n684819c003.summary: Barrick Gold has confirmed the suspension of its operations in Mali after the government seized gold stocks from the Loulo-Gounkoto mining complex. The seizure was valued at $245 million.
n684819c003.why: Barrick Gold is a Toronto-based gold miner, one of the largest producers globally, so operational disruptions at its mines affect its output and the gold supply.

nb58e0b703a.headline: German economy contracts for second year in a row in 2024
nb58e0b703a.summary: The German economy contracted for a second consecutive year in 2024 and was again the weakest among euro zone peers. The input gives no growth figure.
nb58e0b703a.why: Germany is the euro zone's largest economy, so its performance influences regional growth, fiscal debate and the European Central Bank's policy outlook.

n800e1db257.headline: PTSB latest lender to cut fixed mortgage rates
n800e1db257.summary: Irish lender PTSB said it will cut its personal fixed-rate mortgage products by between 0.15 and 0.95 percentage points. It is the latest Irish lender to reduce fixed mortgage rates.
n800e1db257.why: PTSB is an Irish retail bank, and mortgage pricing moves affect its lending margins and competition in Ireland's housing market.

n0a0e47fd5b.headline: Ringgit advances against US dollar at the close
n0a0e47fd5b.summary: The ringgit rose against the US dollar at the close, as demand for the dollar eased after softer US producer price index data. An analyst also cited expectations of gradual US tariff implementation.
n0a0e47fd5b.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect the cost of imports and the returns of foreign investors in Malaysian assets.

nc8e1d2d675.headline: Buyer's market: 2025 to bring relief to home buyers
nc8e1d2d675.summary: A major pullback in house price rises has not stopped the Australian housing market from extending its growth streak, with 2025 expected to bring relief to buyers.
nc8e1d2d675.why: Housing prices feed into household wealth, mortgage demand and bank lending, which shape Australian economic activity and related equities.

n747563c3ea.headline: Restaurant industry welcomes plans to cut VAT rate to 9%
n747563c3ea.summary: A draft government programme proposes cutting VAT to 9% for food services, entertainment and hairdressing in the next budget.
n747563c3ea.why: VAT changes alter consumer prices and margins for hospitality and service businesses.

n2ffc63fb6a.headline: 2025 BYD Atto 3 update revealed in China by regulator
n2ffc63fb6a.summary: A 2025 update to the BYD Atto 3 has been revealed in China by a regulator, with a more aggressive front face and a new bumper camera.
n2ffc63fb6a.why: BYD is one of China's largest electric vehicle makers and competes with Tesla in global EV sales.

nd2353f8699.headline: Nio's Onvo accused of "forcing" employees to purchase L60, VP responds
nd2353f8699.summary: Onvo's vice president clarified a Wenzhou manager's communication about voluntary car purchases, which included discounts, test-drive incentives and a six-month buyback offer.
nd2353f8699.why: Onvo is a brand of Nio, a Chinese electric vehicle maker, and internal sales practices can affect its brand and sales.

ne0091c9270.headline: A sea of red engulfs Bursa Malaysia
ne0091c9270.summary: Bursa Malaysia fell into negative territory again on Wednesday, with almost 1,000 counters closing in the red as investors continued to sell shares amid weak sentiment.
ne0091c9270.why: Bursa Malaysia is the country's stock exchange, and broad declines across listed stocks reflect shifts in domestic investor sentiment.

nbf72ab33a1.headline: US financial deregulation would raise crisis risks, French central bank chief says
nbf72ab33a1.summary: France's central bank governor warned that any moves by the incoming U.S. administration to pursue financial deregulation would increase the risk of a financial crisis one day.
nbf72ab33a1.why: Bank regulation sets capital and risk rules for lenders, and changes to it can affect financial stability and market confidence.

n2d5d673ed5.headline: GM signs supply deal with Vianode for synthetic graphite for EV batteries
n2d5d673ed5.summary: General Motors has signed a multi-year, multi-billion dollar agreement with Norway's Vianode for synthetic graphite used in EV batteries.
n2d5d673ed5.why: General Motors is a major US automaker, and battery materials supply contracts help secure inputs for its electric vehicle program.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: A long-term graphite supply contract secures battery material inputs for GM's EV production.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

naf4b6047f2.headline: Potential impact from US AI chip restrictions to be minimal for Malaysian contractors - CIMB
naf4b6047f2.summary: CIMB Securities Research says potential US restrictions on AI chip exports would have minimal impact on existing data centre contracts of Malaysian contractors at this point.
naf4b6047f2.why: Export controls on advanced chips affect the global semiconductor and data-centre supply chain, which includes contractors in Southeast Asia.

nb59c7943be.headline: Livret A rate lowered to 2.4% on February 1
nb59c7943be.summary: The interest rate on Livret A savings accounts will fall to 2.4% from 3% on February 1, the French Ministry of the Economy and Finance announced on Wednesday.
nb59c7943be.why: The Livret A is a tax-free savings account with a rate set by the French government, and it is one of the most widely held savings products in France. Its rate influences household savings and bank deposit competition.

n4bd72922b4.headline: U Mobile secures financing from CIMB for second 5G network
n4bd72922b4.summary: Malaysian telco U Mobile signed a memorandum of understanding with CIMB Bank to extend financing support for its upcoming 5G network rollout. The announcement was made on Wednesday.
n4bd72922b4.why: U Mobile is a Malaysian mobile operator building a second 5G network, and CIMB is one of Malaysia's largest banks. Telecom network financing reflects the capital needs of infrastructure rollouts.

n5cf5376559.headline: Vancouver’s glut of luxury condos a potential investment opportunity, says Sotheby’s
n5cf5376559.summary: Sotheby's says Vancouver's glut of luxury condos could be a potential investment opportunity. Detached homes remain the leading high-end segment, accounting for 9 in 10 high-end deals.
n5cf5376559.why: Vancouver is a major Canadian housing market, and high-end residential prices are sensitive to interest rates and foreign buyer demand.

n1d118a330f.headline: Phiippine economy seen  to expand by 6.1%
n1d118a330f.summary: Moody's Ratings projects the Philippine economy to grow 6.1% this year, supported by household spending and public investment. The forecast reflects the rating agency's outlook.
n1d118a330f.why: Moody's is a major credit rating agency, and its growth forecasts influence sovereign credit assessments and investor views on emerging markets.

n4c1f132e14.headline: APAS calls for withdrawal, consultation on capital gains tax hike
n4c1f132e14.summary: The APAS has called for the capital gains tax hike to be withdrawn and subjected to consultation. The group said most producers rely on selling their assets as their retirement fund.
n4c1f132e14.why: Capital gains tax changes affect how farmers and other asset owners fund retirement through asset sales, which can influence land prices and farm succession.

n7139dc0713.headline: Ex-Bank of Canada governor Carney will enter race to replace PM Trudeau - CBC
n7139dc0713.summary: Former Bank of Canada governor Mark Carney will announce he is running to replace Prime Minister Justin Trudeau as Liberal leader, CBC News reported. The announcement was expected Thursday.
n7139dc0713.why: Mark Carney previously led the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England, so his leadership bid is closely watched by investors for its implications for monetary and fiscal policy.

nbc593efc0b.headline: Ex-Bank of Canada governor Carney will enter race to replace PM Trudeau - CBC
nbc593efc0b.summary: Former Bank of Canada governor Mark Carney will announce he is running to replace Prime Minister Justin Trudeau as Liberal Party leader, CBC News reported.
nbc593efc0b.why: The Bank of Canada sets the country's benchmark interest rate, and leadership changes at the ruling party can shape Canada's fiscal and economic policy direction.

n5a229f5730.headline: USD/JPY Price Analysis: Yen Climbs on BoJ Tightening Odds
n5a229f5730.summary: The USD/JPY pair shows rising bets for a Bank of Japan rate hike, supporting the yen.
n5a229f5730.why: A rate hike by the BoJ would impact currency markets and Japan’s monetary policy stance.
n5a229f5730.why_moved: Market bets on a BoJ rate hike support the yen, influencing currency trading and monetary policy outlooks.
